items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: I met Adderly Hall when she got back here to America, and she worked with us... We went to Chicago, we went to different cities to play vaudeville with her.

ctx.x: And I used to tell the guy, (unintelligible). He says, well, he's (unintelligible) in one eye, but anyway he always had a man with him, and they can fix his car and put a ______ in the corner of one eye and he can play. So I guess at that time

he was not completely blind. That's what he told me. And then he went to Paris as a piano player for Adderly Hall. And I met Adderly Hall when she got back here to America, and she worked with us, with the (unintelligible). We went to Chicago, we went to different cities to play vaudeville with her.
